title: Coordinates of the transported ordinary completion chain
statement: For prime l, finite E/Q_l and arbitrary h:U→T, take any complex P and a module pullback identification a between the two coefficient presentations [def-weil-pbc-proper-integral-ordinary-data]. Suppose t identifies the actual pulled strict quotient tower with the transported ordinary quotient tower, preserving the specified quotient augmentations, and z identifies the transported ordinary Roos complex with the actual Roos complex with both prescribed coordinate formulas. Put j=mapHomologicalComplex(a) at P and c=j.inv followed by scalar restriction of ordinaryIntegralCompletionChain(P) followed by z.hom [def-sf-ordinary-integral-pullback-construction]. Then j.hom followed by c is the transported ordinary chain followed by z.hom, every first product projection of c is the actual quotient augmentation, and its shifted second coordinate is zero. No K-flatness, resolution or derived-unit normalization is assumed.

source.place: Tag 0941, lemma-derived-limit-is-ok proof, with the quotient augmentation of Tag 08TC and Bhatt--Scholze Lemma 6.5.9(4).

proof.text: Construct c as the inverse module identification followed by scalar restriction of the ordinary completion chain and z. The inverse identities give j.hom followed by c equal to the transported chain followed by z.hom.

At each first product projection, use the first coordinate of z. Functoriality combines the ordinary chain with its first product projection. The mapping-cocone lift and product-lift equations give the ordinary quotient augmentation. The supplied augmentation identity, followed by the inverse of t, and cancellation of j give the actual augmentation.

For the shifted coordinate, use product extensionality in each degree, the second coordinate of z, functoriality, and the zero shifted coordinate of the ordinary mapping-cocone lift. Scalar restriction preserves zero. This includes the zero complex and empty schemes.

theorem pbc_integral_completion_transport_coordinates
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra ℚ_[l] E]
    [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E] {U T : Scheme.{u}} (h : U ⟶ T)
    (a : ordinaryIntegralModulePull l E h ⋙ pbcIntegralTransportModules U l E ≅
      pbcIntegralTransportModules T l E ⋙ completedModulePullback h (pbcIntegralDatum l E))
    (P : CochainComplex (integralTowerModules l E T) ℤ)
    (t : (pbcIntegralActualTower l E h P).asFunctor ≅
      (integralOperationsPullbackTowerFunctor l E h).obj P ⋙ pbcIntegralTransportComplex U l E)
    (z : (pbcIntegralTransportComplex U l E).obj
      ((integralOperationsPullbackComplexFunctor l E h).obj P) ≅
      integralOperationsRoos (pbcIntegralActualTower l E h P).asFunctor)
    (ht : ∀ n : ℕ, (NatTrans.mapHomologicalComplex a.hom (.up ℤ)).app P ≫
      pbcIntegralActualTowerAugmentation l E h P n ≫ t.hom.app (op n) =
      (pbcIntegralTransportComplex U l E).map
        (((ordinaryIntegralQuotientAugmentation l E h).app P).app (op n)))
    (hz : PbcIntegralRoosTransportCoordinates U l E
      (pbcIntegralActualTower l E h P).asFunctor
      ((integralOperationsPullbackTowerFunctor l E h).obj P) t z) :
    let G := pbcIntegralTransportComplex U l E
    let j := (NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex a (.up ℤ)).app P
    let c := j.inv ≫ G.map (ordinaryIntegralCompletionChain l E h P) ≫ z.hom
    (j.hom ≫ c = G.map (ordinaryIntegralCompletionChain l E h P) ≫ z.hom) ∧
    (∀ (n : ℕ) (i : ℤ),
      c.f i ≫ (CochainComplex.mappingCocone.fst
        (towerTransitionEndomorphism
        (K := fun m : ℕ ↦ (pbcIntegralActualTower l E h P).asFunctor.obj (op m))
        (integralOperationsTowerStep (pbcIntegralActualTower l E h P).asFunctor))).f i ≫
        (Pi.π (fun m : ℕ ↦
          (pbcIntegralActualTower l E h P).asFunctor.obj (op m)) n).f i =
        (pbcIntegralActualTowerAugmentation l E h P n).f i) ∧
    (∀ (i j' : ℤ) (hij : i + -1 = j'),
      c.f i ≫ (CochainComplex.mappingCocone.snd
        (towerTransitionEndomorphism
        (K := fun m : ℕ ↦ (pbcIntegralActualTower l E h P).asFunctor.obj (op m))
        (integralOperationsTowerStep (pbcIntegralActualTower l E h P).asFunctor))).v
          i j' hij = 0)
